content.rendered:
Martin Luther King, Jr., Day is a federal holiday in the United States honoring the achievements of Martin Luther King, Jr., a Baptist minister and civil rights leader who advocated for nonviolent resistance against racial segregation.

This year the holiday will be observed on Monday, January 16, 2023. Schools will be closed this day.
